Bike shops in New York: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in New York that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: TD Five Boro Bike Tour.

Bike shops in New York: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. NYC Velo (East Village)

    66 2nd Avenue, New York, NY 10003 · (212) 253-7771

    repairrentalparts

    Full-service shop about 2.5 miles north of the start; rentals through rentals.nycvelo.com.

  2. BikeFixNYC

    334 East 6th Street, New York, NY 10003 · (347) 463-3876

    repairparts

    Repair-focused East Village shop, open seven days; no rentals.

  3. Circles In Motion

    151 West 19th Street, New York, NY 10011 · (212) 206-7656

    repairparts

    Chelsea repair shop about three miles up from Bowling Green.

  4. Waterfront Bicycle Shop

    repairrentalparts

    West Village shop open since 2009 on the Hudson Greenway side; on-the-spot repairs, $125 tune-ups and hybrid and road rentals. Confirm the street address on their site.
